beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A scientific agent can finish a convincing report without establishing everything it appears to claim.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Executable Scientific Intelligence examines the machinery needed to expose that difference.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its proposal is a research instrument built from inspectable, task-specific circuits.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book separates what a system proposes, computes, verifies, and may legitimately assert.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You will encounter an architectural argument, working prototypes, and unresolved research questions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The objective is greater scientific capability with explicit limits on authority.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That makes the book relevant wherever fluent explanations are beginning to substitute for inspectable work.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Scientific prose remains essential because new ideas often arrive before stable formal definitions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Yet a paragraph can hide dependencies across data, methods, software, and assumptions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Rerunning code does not automatically reveal which claim its output supports.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book proposes an executable companion for the portions that can be formalized.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The original explanation remains available alongside its evidence and computational relationships.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A new question would activate relevant procedures rather than repeat an entire research workflow.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This opening distinction explains why the project concerns scientific objects, not merely faster chat.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The foundations begin by distinguishing structures that are all commonly called graphs.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A citation edge records a relationship between documents or claims.
